payload.answer: Ask at once; leave old folders (Recommended)

options.description: A hidden regression stops the agent and asks you right away, and holds the merge. Only sessions ending after the change get their folders removed.
options.label: Ask at once; leave old folders (Recommended)

options.description: Same, but the first landing also clears the backlog of older dead-session folders.
options.label: Ask at once; clear old folders too

options.description: No interruption during the turn; the merge check lists it and holds. Old folders stay.
options.label: Flag at merge; leave old folders

options.description: No interruption; the merge check holds. The backlog of old folders is cleared too.
options.label: Flag at merge; clear old folders

payload.question: Two remaining choices. A test of an approved example is rewritten so that a behaviour which used to fail now passes: should plumb stop the agent and ask you at once (and hold the merge), or only flag it at the merge check? And when plumb starts removing ended sessions' folders, should it also clear the folders of sessions that ended before this change?
